name: Isosurface Similarity Map (ISM)
definition: A symmetric N×N matrix SMV(i, j) that records the similarity between every pair of isosurfaces generated from a discrete set of N isovalues V = {h1, ..., hN}. It provides an overview of similarity relationships in the dataset, unlike histograms which show frequency.
summary: The Isosurface Similarity Map is a symmetric matrix quantifying geometric similarity between isosurfaces via normalized mutual information of distance transforms, distinct from histogram-based methods.
